name: Meribah
overview: The account of Meribah in Exodus 17 reveals a critical moment when the Israelites, journeying through Rephidim, faced a severe lack of water, leading them to quarrel with Moses and test the Lord's patience. In response to their desperate cries, God instructed Moses to strike a rock at Horeb, from which water miraculously flowed to sustain the people. This event underscores God's provision and faithfulness even amid Israel's complaints and doubts, highlighting His power to meet physical needs through miraculous means.
